exposure: Gestational age ≥ 20 weeks at the time of infection
severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection
cohort: 177 pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection at a tertiary hospital between May 2020 and November 2021
finding: Pregnant women with severe COVID-19 were at increased risk of adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes, including premature delivery, cesarean section, ICU admission, and maternal death, while severe SARS-CoV-2 infection was not directly associated with low birth weight or need for neonatal resuscitation.
mod_finding: Severe forms of COVID-19 increased the risk of premature delivery and emergency cesarean delivery.
gest_age: Gestational age ≥ 20 weeks at the time of infection
